title: Replay forwarded x549 and bound the nine old feedback directions
body:
## Mathematical result

Forward x549 through the funded 0→19→182 route. The native chart-268 source values return and owner 679 is correct in both orientations. Omitting 789 from the retargeted feedback leaves one adjoint error at owner 17 and 63 forward errors. Replacing the old 2944 payload can deliver e17, while a first-reader probe shows the resulting loss at packet 3301. The independent rank-nine theorem grants arbitrary recoding of all nine chart-0 incoming scalars with full original frozen source histories, even if future. The five chart-421 rows intersect the required nine-dimensional quotient trivially.

## Sources

Canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 and #8006 4035f150285513852cab8d00b8bfc233c699ea0a. #8008 and #8009 are the relevant funded-contact and literal old-value controls.

## Validation

Both cold manifests and three isolated control replays passed. The proofs cover the two-bank quotient, all historical nine-bank alternatives and four exact 680-row diagnostics with signed invoices.

## Open next questions

Change earlier source values or the paid directions required at chart 0, then reproduce the full map.
